title: Hard-coded password, secret or API key found in 3 file(s)
technical_impact: Credentials are committed to the source tree. Anyone with read access to the repository, its history or a backup can use them.
business_impact: Passwords or keys are written inside the code. Whoever gets a copy of the code gets access to the systems those keys open.
recommendation: Rotate these credentials now, move them to a secrets store (environment, vault), and purge them from the git history.
